categorical_missing.why: No missing values; kept for completeness.

rare_level_threshold.why: All levels hold >= 25% of rows; nothing to pool.

drop_columns.why: All six attributes are design inputs of the car evaluation; none redundant.

class_imbalance_note.why: Minority classes good/vgood are 4% each (ratio 18.6:1); macro-F1 weighs them equally and class_weight=balanced is searched.

cv.why: Multiclass with tiny classes (~52 training rows): macro-F1 gives each class equal weight; 10 folds because n_train = 1382 < 2000 (each fold still has ~5 vgood rows).

models.label: Logistic Regression
models.why: Multinomial linear model on one-hot attributes: tests whether acceptability is an additive score of attribute levels. No scaling needed for 0/1 inputs. Stopping: lbfgs tolerance 1e-4.

models.label: Hist. Gradient Boosting
models.why: Captures interactions: car acceptability is defined by hierarchical rules (e.g. any car with safety=low or persons=2 is unacceptable), which a tree can represent directly. min_samples_leaf range lowered to [2,30] because the smallest class has ~52 rows. Stopping: early stopping on 10% validation split, patience 30.

ablations.question: HGB: one-hot instead of native categorical splits
